incident_type.title: Reports by incident type
incident_type.description: Each video counts once: its official report, else its newest.
incident_type.meaning: count per incident type: "incident distribution", "what types of incident"

severity.title: Reports by severity
severity.description: Each video counts once: its official report, else its newest. Low is level 1-2, medium is 3, high is 4-5.

report_status.title: Official and not official reports
report_status.description: Each video counts once: its official report, else its newest. Not official means no report has been marked official yet.
report_status.meaning: how many reports are official and how many are not

report_kind.title: Reports by version
report_kind.description: Each video counts once: its official report, else its newest. As the model generated them, or saved by a reviewer.

report_day.title: Reports per day
report_day.description: Each video counts once: its official report, else its newest. By report date.
report_day.meaning: count per day of the report date: "trends over time", "daily incidents"

report_week.title: Reports per week
report_week.description: Each video counts once: its official report, else its newest. By report date, in weeks from Monday.
report_week.meaning: count per week of the report date

report_month.title: Reports per month
report_month.description: Each video counts once: its official report, else its newest. By report date.
report_month.meaning: count per month of the report date

report_weekday.title: Report activity by weekday
report_weekday.description: Reports by the weekday they were generated, in your time zone. This is not when an incident happened.
report_weekday.meaning: reports per weekday they were generated, never the weekday an incident happened

report_hour.title: Report activity by hour
report_hour.description: Reports by the hour they were generated, in your time zone. This is not when an incident happened.
report_hour.meaning: reports per hour they were generated, never the hour an incident happened

entity_type.title: Reports by entity type
entity_type.description: Reports involving each entity type. A report can count under more than one.
entity_type.meaning: incidents involving humans, animals or unknown entities

instrument.title: Top instruments
instrument.description: The eight most common instruments, by reports naming each. A report can count under more than one.

asset.title: Top assets
asset.description: The eight most common assets, by reports naming each. A report can count under more than one.

confidence.title: Model confidence distribution
confidence.description: Reports by the confidence the model gave. Reports with no confidence value are left out.

threat_level.title: Instrument threat levels
threat_level.description: Instruments in the counted reports, by rated threat.
threat_level.meaning: count of instruments per threat level

model.title: Analyses by model
model.description: Every analysis attempt in the period, all runs and not only reports.

analysis_outcome.title: Analyses by outcome
analysis_outcome.description: Every analysis attempt in the period, all runs and not only reports.
analysis_outcome.meaning: analysis attempts per outcome: valid, repaired, failed

incident_type_evidence.title: Evidence per report by incident type
incident_type_evidence.description: Each video counts once: its official report, else its newest. Bars are the reports of each type; the line is its evidence items per report (each entity, instrument and asset item).
incident_type_evidence.meaning: reports per incident type as bars, with evidence items per report as a line on a second axis: "evidence per report by type", "which types produce the most evidence"

incident_type_severity.title: Severity within each incident type
incident_type_severity.description: Each video counts once: its official report, else its newest. Each bar is one incident type, split into high, medium and low severity. Low is level 1-2, medium is 3, high is 4-5.
incident_type_severity.meaning: severity inside each incident type, one stacked bar per type: "severity by incident type", "severity within each type"; never the plain severity breakdown, which is the severity dimension

severity_evidence.title: Severity against evidence
severity_evidence.description: Each video counts once: its official report, else its newest. Each bubble is one severity level (1 to 5) and one evidence item count; its size is the number of reports with that pair.
severity_evidence.meaning: evidence items against severity level, one bubble per level and item count, sized by reports: "do more severe incidents have more evidence", "severity against evidence"
